emperors.bio_md:
# 元惠宗(顺帝)妥欢帖睦尔 · 主要事迹

孛儿只斤妥欢帖睦尔（1320—1370），明宗长子，幼年随父流亡，明宗暴崩后辗转于广西、北边。至顺四年（1333）宁宗崩后，燕铁木儿迎之即位，改元元统，是为元惠宗（明人称元顺帝）。

惠宗在位三十六年，是元朝在位最久的皇帝。前期伯颜专权，罢科举、禁汉学；脱脱主政后行「至正新政」，复科举、开河渠、修三史，一度中兴气象。然至正十一年（1351）红巾军起于颍州，天下鼎沸，群雄并起；至正二十八年（1368）明军克大都，惠宗弃城北奔上都，元朝在中原的统治结束，史称北元。

洪武三年（1370）惠宗崩于应昌，庙号惠宗。一代王朝，以「至正新政」始、以「北遁应昌」终。

bio_parts_en.value:
Borjigin Toghon Temur (1320-1370), eldest son of Mingzong, drifted through Guangxi and the marches after his father's sudden death. When Ningzong died in 1333, El Temur brought him to the throne, era Yuantong - Emperor Huizong (called Shundi by the Ming).

His thirty-six years were the longest of any Yuan emperor. Under Bayan came proscription and the suspension of examinations; under Toqto'a the Zhizheng renewal - examinations restored, canals dug, the Three Histories compiled - a brief revival. But in 1351 the Red Turbans rose at Yingzhou and the realm erupted; in 1368 the Ming took Dadu and Huizong fled north to Shangdu, ending Yuan rule in China and beginning the Northern Yuan.

He died at Yingchang in 1370, given the temple name Huizong in the north. A dynasty that began with the Zhizheng renewal and ended in flight to Yingchang.

emperors.summary_en: Rising from peasant origins, he drove out the Yuan and fixed the capital at Nanjing; abolishing the chancellorship and ruling with stern law, he laid the Ming institutions.

# 明太祖朱元璋 · 主要事迹

朱元璋（1328—1398），濠州（今安徽凤阳）贫农出身，父母兄长在饥疫中相继死去，他入皇觉寺为僧，又出外游方乞食。至正十二年（1352）投郭子兴红巾军，以骁勇善谋渐掌兵权，先后取集庆（南京）、败陈友谅、灭张士诚、降方国珍，至正二十八年（1368）即皇帝位于应天，国号明，建元洪武。

洪武一朝，朱元璋行重典治乱世：废中书省及丞相，权归六部，皇权独揽；设锦衣卫，屡兴大狱，胡惟庸案、蓝玉案株连功臣数万，「功臣宿将殆尽」。同时他整顿吏治、丈量土地、屯田垦荒，轻徭薄赋，洪武之治使战后民生渐苏。

洪武三十一年（1398）太祖崩于南京，庙号太祖。他出身寒微而取天下，勤政严刑，功过皆极——有明一代的制度底色，尽出于此。

bio_parts_en.value:
Zhu Yuanzhang (1328-1398), a poor peasant of Haozhou, lost his parents and brother to famine and plague, took refuge in a monastery, and wandered as a mendicant. In 1352 he joined Guo Zixing's Red Turban army, rose by valor and cunning, took Jiqing (Nanjing), destroyed Chen Youliang, crushed Zhang Shicheng, and received Fang Guozhen's surrender - and in 1368 took the imperial title at Yingtian as founder of the Ming, era Hongwu.

He ruled with harsh law: the Secretariat and chancellorship were abolished, all power gathering in the throne; the Embroidered Uniform Guard was founded; the Hu Weiyong and Lanyu cases swept away tens of thousands, nearly all the meritorious generals. Yet he also disciplined officials, surveyed land, opened farmland, and lightened taxes - the Hongwu years revived a war-torn realm.

He died at Nanjing in 1398, posthumously Taizu. From the meanest birth to the empire, diligent and cruel, his legacy defines the Ming.

# 建文帝朱允炆 · 主要事迹

朱允炆（1377—1402），[[ming-tai-zu|太祖]]之孙，太子朱标之子。洪武三十一年（1398）太祖崩，允炆即位，改元建文。

建文帝用齐泰、黄子澄、方孝孺等，行宽仁之政，锐意削藩：周、齐、湘、代、岷诸王先后被废，矛头直指燕王[[ming-cheng-zu|朱棣]]。建文元年（1399）朱棣以「靖难」为名起兵北平，四年南下，建文四年（1402）兵入南京，宫中火起，建文帝下落不明——「逊国」之谜流传至今，或云焚死，或云削发为僧云游。

建文四年之政本为宽仁，惜削藩操之过急，以速祸亡；其下落不明与成祖夺位，为明初第一大公案。

bio_parts_en.value: Zhu Yunwen (1377-1402), grandson of

and son of Crown Prince Biao, took the throne in 1398, era Jianwen.

With Qi Tai, Huang Zicheng, and Fang Xiaoru he governed with leniency and pressed the reduction of the feudal princes: Zhou, Qi, Xiang, Dai, and Min were stripped in turn, the sword aimed at the Prince of Yan,

. In 1399 Zhu Di rose in the "Jingnan" war from Beiping; in 1402 his armies entered Nanjing, fire rose in the palace, and the Jianwen emperor vanished - burned, some say, or fled as a tonsured wanderer. The mystery outlives the dynasty.

# 明成祖朱棣 · 主要事迹

朱棣（1360—1424），[[ming-tai-zu|太祖]]第四子，封燕王，镇守北平。建文元年（1399）以「靖难」为名起兵，称帝前本人统军南下，建文四年（1402）入南京，夺位称帝，改元永乐。

成祖一朝，武功极盛：五征漠北，亲御六师扫荡残元势力；遣郑和七下西洋，远帆至于东非；迁都北京，「天子守国门」。内政上设内阁、修《永乐大典》，文治亦盛。然其以篡得位，诛方孝孺等建文诸臣，瓜蔓抄捕极惨，为后世所讥。

永乐二十二年（1424）成祖崩于榆木川北征归途。雄才大略、文治武功并盛，而夺位之疑终身不释。

bio_parts_en.value: Zhu Di (1360-1424), fourth son of

, Prince of Yan, guarded Beiping. In 1399 he rose in the "Jingnan" war, commanding his armies in person before taking the throne, and entered Nanjing in 1402 as emperor, era Yongle.

His reign was one of arms and splendor: five personal campaigns into the steppe against the remnants of the Yuan; Zheng He's seven voyages reaching East Africa; the capital moved to Beijing, "the Son of Heaven guarding the gate." In government he founded the Grand Secretariat and compiled the Yongle Encyclopedia. Yet he won by usurpation, executed Fang Xiaoru and the Jianwen loyalists, and punished their kin to the fourth degree - a stain never washed away.

He died at Yumuchuan in 1424, returning from the north. Rarely has an emperor combined such genius with such a tainted claim.

# 明仁宗朱高炽 · 主要事迹

朱高炽（1378—1425），[[ming-cheng-zu|成祖]]长子，性仁厚，成祖北征时多次监国。永乐二十二年（1424）成祖崩于榆木川，高炽即位，改元洪熙。

仁宗即位即施仁政：罢西洋宝船、减赋役、赦建文旧臣，起用杨士奇等，朝野归心。惜在位仅十月而崩，年四十八。

仁宗之政虽短，其宽仁之基为「仁宣之治」所承。史称「洪熙宣德，庶几仁宗之政」，为明前期最安定的岁月。

bio_parts_en.value: Zhu Gaochi (1378-1425), eldest son of

, was mild by nature and often regent during his father's northern campaigns. When Chengzu died at Yumuchuan in 1424, Gaochi took the throne, era Hongxi.

He opened with benevolence: the western voyages were halted, taxes lightened, the Jianwen loyalists pardoned, Yang Shiqi and others called to office - the realm settled. He reigned only ten months, dying at forty-eight.

Brief as it was, his benevolence underlay the Ren-Xuan peace, the most tranquil years of early Ming.

# 明宣宗朱瞻基 · 主要事迹

朱瞻基（1399—1435），[[ming-ren-zong|仁宗]]长子。洪熙元年（1425）即位，改元宣德。

宣德元年（1426）汉王高煦反于乐安，宣宗亲征，一鼓平之；又决然弃交趾布政司，罢海外远略，收缩以养国力。内政上三杨（杨士奇、杨荣、杨溥）辅政，勤政纳谏，宣德之治号为明盛之极。

宣德十年（1435）宣宗崩，子英宗即位。他于盛时谢世，身后之明由盛转衰——「宣德以后，明政渐坏」，其盛极之界正在于此。

bio_parts_en.value: Zhu Zhanji (1399-1435), eldest son of

, took the throne in 1425, era Xuande.

In 1426 the Prince of Han revolted at Le'an; Xuanzong campaigned in person and crushed him in one move. He then resolutely abandoned the Jiaozhi commandery, ending distant ventures to husband the state's strength. With the Three Yangs - Yang Shiqi, Yang Rong, Yang Pu - guiding him, he governed diligently, and the Xuande age is counted the summit of Ming prosperity.

He died in 1435, his son succeeding. He departed at the peak; the decline that followed marks his reign as the turning point.

# 明英宗朱祁镇(正统) · 主要事迹

朱祁镇（1427—1464），[[ming-xuan-zong|宣宗]]长子，宣德十年（1435）九岁即位，改元正统。

英宗前期太皇太后与三杨辅政，尚称清平；正统中期宦官王振用事，军政败坏。正统十四年（1449），王振挟帝亲征瓦剌，八月于土木堡（今河北怀来）兵败，英宗被俘，史称「土木之变」。瓦剌挟帝叩关，京师震动。

其弟[[ming-dai-zong|郕王]]即位（景泰帝），于谦守北京退瓦剌；次年英宗被释还京，尊为太上皇，幽居南宫。其北狩之辱为明室前所未有。

bio_parts_en.value: Zhu Qizhen (1427-1464), eldest son of

, took the throne at nine in 1435, era Zhengtong.

His early years ran under the grand dowager and the Three Yangs; from mid-reign the eunuch Wang Zhen dominated and government decayed. In 1449 Wang Zhen dragged the emperor into a personal campaign against the Oirats; in August, at Tumu, the army was shattered and Yingzong captured - the Tumu Incident. The Oirats pressed the capital with the emperor in train.

His younger brother

took the throne (Jingtai), and Yu Qian held Beijing against Esen. Released the next year, Yingzong returned as retired emperor, confined in the Southern Palace. The humiliation of his captivity was unprecedented in Ming history.

emperors.summary: 土木之变后监国即位，任于谦守北京退瓦剌；迎还英宗而废其子，夺门之变后被废，崩于西内。
emperors.summary_en: After the Tumu disaster he took the throne, entrusted Yu Qian with the defense of Beijing, welcomed Yingzong back only to depose his son, and was himself deposed in the Restoration coup, dying in the western palace.

# 明代宗朱祁钰(景泰) · 主要事迹

朱祁钰（1428—1457），[[ming-xuan-zong|宣宗]]次子，封郕王。正统十四年（1449）土木之变，[[ming-ying-zong-a|英宗]]被俘，郕王监国即位，改元景泰，尊英宗为太上皇。

景泰帝任于谦为兵部尚书，组织北京保卫战，击退瓦剌也先之围，再造大明。景泰元年（1450）迎还太上皇，幽于南宫，并废英宗之子朱见深之储位，改立己子——此为夺门之变的伏线。

景泰八年（1457）正月，石亨、徐有贞等发动夺门之变，迎英宗复位；代宗被废为郕王，月余而崩（一说被弑）。守国之功与废储之过并见，身后谥号曰「景帝」。

bio_parts_en.value: Zhu Qiyu (1428-1457), second son of
, Prince of Cheng. After the Tumu disaster, with

in captivity, he was raised from regent to emperor in 1449, era Jingtai, honoring his brother as retired emperor.

He entrusted Yu Qian with the Ministry of War; the defense of Beijing repelled Esen's siege and the realm was saved. In 1450 Yingzong was welcomed back and confined in the Southern Palace; Daizong then deposed the heir, his nephew, in favor of his own son - the seed of the Restoration coup.

# 明英宗朱祁镇(天顺) · 主要事迹

景泰八年（1457）正月夺门之变，[[ming-ying-zong-a|英宗]]复辟，改元天顺。

复辟当日即杀于谦于市，天下冤之；其后信用石亨、曹吉祥等夺门功臣，二人旋谋反被诛，是为「曹石之变」。天顺之政无大善亦无大恶，英宗晚年感悟，临终遗诏罢宫妃殉葬之制——此制自太祖始行六朝，废之为一善政。

天顺八年（1464）英宗崩，庙号英宗，葬裕陵。他两度在位，前惑于宦官、后惑于权臣，而罢殉之仁可赎其过。

bio_parts_en.value: In 1457 the Restoration coup brought

back to the throne, era Tianshun.

That very day he executed Yu Qian in the market, to the grief of the realm. He trusted the Restoration men Shi Heng and Cao Jixiang, who rose against him in turn - the Cao-Shi revolt - and were crushed. His later years were quiet; on his deathbed in 1464 he decreed an end to the custom of burying concubines with the emperor - a practice kept for six reigns, abolished at his word.

Twice enthroned, misled first by a eunuch and then by ministers, he was redeemed by that single act of mercy.

# 明宪宗朱见深 · 主要事迹

朱见深（1447—1487），[[ming-ying-zong-b|英宗]]长子，幼历土木之变与废立之危。天顺八年（1464）即位，改元成化。

成化初年，宪宗为于谦昭雪，朝野称快；然其宠万贵妃，后宫用事，又设西厂，汪直横行；创「传奉官」之制，不经铨选而由内降授官，卖官鬻爵之门由此而开。

成化二十三年（1487）宪宗崩，庙号宪宗。其政由英宗朝之乱入于权幸之手，明之中衰自此而始。

bio_parts_en.value: Zhu Jianshen (1447-1487), eldest son of

, endured the Tumu years and deposition as a child. He took the throne in 1464, era Chenghua.

He began well, clearing Yu Qian's name; but he doted on Consort Wan, whose favor dominated the court, set up the Western Depot under the eunuch Wang Zhi, and created the "transmitted appointments" - offices granted by palace fiat without examination, opening the door to purchased rank.

He died in 1487. Under his favor of eunuchs and consorts, the middle-Ming decay began.

emperors.summary_en: Son of Xianzong and the only Ming emperor with one wife, he employed the worthy, heeded remonstrance, and cleared the offices; the Hongzhi era was the cleanest of the middle Ming.

# 明孝宗朱祐樘 · 主要事迹

朱祐樘（1470—1505），[[ming-xian-zong|宪宗]]之子，母为纪姓宫女，幼年遭万贵妃之厄，藏于后宫密养。成化二十三年（1487）即位，改元弘治。

孝宗是唯一一夫一妻之帝，终身不置妃嫔。他任刘健、谢迁、李东阳等贤相，勤政纳谏，罢传奉官、裁抑中官，弘治之治为明中叶仅见之清明。史称「弘治君臣，有可称述」。

弘治十八年（1505）孝宗崩，庙号孝宗，葬泰陵。其独子[[ming-wu-zong|武宗]]即位后，明政又入于佚乐之途。

Xiaozong was the only Ming emperor with a single wife, no concubines ever. He employed Liu Jian, Xie Qian, and Li Dongyang, heard remonstrance, cleared the transmitted offices, and curbed the eunuchs - the Hongzhi years were the cleanest of the middle Ming.

He died in 1505. His only son
undid much of it, but the Hongzhi example stood.

, took the throne in 1505, era Zhengde.

Wuzong loved pleasure, favored the eunuch Liu Jin and the "Eight Tigers," and after Liu Jin's execution lived in the Leopard House, styling himself "Grand Generalissimo." In 1517 he faced the Tatar prince in person at Yingzhou; in 1519, when the Prince of Ning rose at Nanchang, he led a personal campaign, arriving at Nanjing after Wang Yangming had already quelled it.

He died in the Leopard House in 1521, without issue. Notorious for dissipation, he yet fought in person and put down rebellion.

# 明世宗朱厚熜 · 主要事迹

朱厚熜（1507—1566），兴献王之子，[[ming-wu-zong|武宗]]堂弟。正德十六年（1521）武宗无子而崩，厚熜入继大统，改元嘉靖。

即位初年，世宗惩刘瑾余党、议行新政，颇有振作；然「大礼议」之争（追尊生父兴献王为皇考）延续数年，廷杖贬谪无算，君臣离心。嘉靖中后期世宗崇道斋醮，移居西苑二十年不朝；严嵩当国二十余年，边备废弛，壬寅宫变宫婢谋弑，庚戌之变俺答兵临城下，京师戒严。

嘉靖四十五年（1566）世宗崩于乾清宫。明政之衰，实自嘉靖始。

bio_parts_en.value: Zhu Houcong (1507-1566), son of the Prince of Xing and cousin of

, entered the line of succession in 1521, era Jiajing.

He began with vigor, punishing the eunuchs and proposing reform; but the Great Ritual Controversy - honoring his birth father as imperial father - raged for years with beatings and demotions, alienating the court. From mid-reign he turned to Daoist rites, dwelling in the Western Park for twenty years without court; Yan Song ruled for two decades, the border rotted, palace maids tried to strangle him in 1542, and in 1550 Altan Khan's cavalry reached the walls of the capital.

He died in the Qianqing Palace in 1566. The Ming decline truly began with Jiajing.

# 明穆宗朱载垕 · 主要事迹

朱载垕（1537—1572），[[ming-shi-zong|世宗]]第三子，封裕王，嘉靖四十五年（1566）世宗崩后即位，改元隆庆。

隆庆六年（1572）穆宗崩，庙号穆宗。其善政虽短，为张居正万历新政之先声。

bio_parts_en.value: Zhu Zaihou (1537-1572), third son of

, Prince Yu, took the throne in 1566, era Longqing.

His six years were energetic: Gao Gong and Zhang Juzheng entered the Grand Secretariat; in 1570, when Altan Khan's grandson surrendered to Ming, the "Altan enfeoffment" followed - Altan was created Prince Shunyi in 1571 with markets opened, and the northern border rested. The maritime ban was also eased in the "Longqing opening."

He died in 1572. His brief good governance prepared Zhang Juzheng's Wanli reforms.

# 明神宗朱翊钧 · 主要事迹

朱翊钧（1563—1620），[[ming-mu-zong|穆宗]]之子，隆庆六年（1572）十岁即位，改元万历。

即位之初，张居正为顾命辅政，行考成法、清丈田亩、一条鞭法，是为万历新政，国库充盈、吏治整肃，为明后期最有力之改革。万历十年（1582）居正卒，神宗亲政后反攻倒算，抄没其家；此后神宗怠于政事，三十余年不朝，矿税太监横行天下，东林党争渐起。军事上宁夏、播州、朝鲜三大征皆遣将；万历四十七年（1619）萨尔浒之役大败于后金，辽东之势遂倾。

万历四十八年（1620）神宗崩，庙号神宗。前十年之治与后三十年之怠判若两朝，明之亡种于此。

bio_parts_en.value: Zhu Yijun (1563-1620), son of

, took the throne at ten in 1572, era Wanli.

Under the guardian Zhang Juzheng came the Wanli reforms: the performance-examination system, land surveys, the Single Whip tax - the most effective reform of the late Ming, filling the treasury and disciplining officialdom. Juzheng died in 1582; Shenzong turned on his memory, confiscating his estate, then withdrew from government for thirty years. Mining-tax eunuchs ravaged the provinces and the Donglin faction wars began. In war, the Three Great Campaigns (Ningxia, Bozhou, Korea) were fought by generals; in 1619 the Sarhu defeat broke the hold on Liaodong.

He died in 1620. A first decade of governance and three of neglect - two reigns in one emperor, and the fall was seeded there.

emperors.summary_en: Son of Shenzong, made heir after the long succession struggle, he distributed the treasury and repealed the mining taxes on accession - and died within a month in the Red Pill case, first of the Ming palace mysteries.

# 明光宗朱常洛 · 主要事迹

朱常洛（1582—1620），[[ming-shen-zong|神宗]]长子，母为宫人。神宗宠郑贵妃欲立其子福王常洵，「国本之争」延绵十五年，常洛方得立储。

万历四十八年（1620）神宗崩，常洛即位，拟改元泰昌。即位即发内帑犒军、罢矿税，朝野称快；然登基一月余即病，服鸿胪寺丞李可灼所进「红丸」，一夕而崩，史称「红丸案」，与梃击案、移宫案并称明末三大案。

光宗在位一月而崩，泰昌年号未及施行。明室之衰至此，已近甲申。

bio_parts_en.value: Zhu Changluo (1582-1620), eldest son of

by a palace maid, spent fifteen years in the succession struggle against the Consort Zheng faction before he was made heir.

When Shenzong died in 1620, Changluo took the throne, planning the Taichang era. He distributed the treasury to the armies and repealed the mining taxes, to general acclaim - then fell ill within the month, took the "Red Pill" of Li Kezhuo, and died overnight: the Red Pill case, one of the three great palace mysteries of the late Ming.

An emperor of one month; the Taichang era never ran. The dynasty by then was sliding toward 1644.

emperors.summary_en: Son of Guangzong, fond of carpentry while Wei Zhongxian ruled; the Donglin massacre and eunuch tyranny marked his reign, brightened only by the Ningyuan victory.

# 明熹宗朱由校 · 主要事迹

朱由校（1605—1627），[[ming-guang-zong|光宗]]长子，泰昌元年（1620）即位，改元天启。

熹宗好木工，斧凿之暇不亲政务，政柄尽归太监魏忠贤。魏忠贤自号「九千岁」，阉党构陷东林党人，杨涟、左光斗等惨死狱中，史称「东林党祸」；天启五年（1625）毁天下书院，党禁之酷为明末之最。军事上天启六年（1626）袁崇焕宁远大捷，炮伤努尔哈赤，辽东稍安。

天启七年（1627）熹宗崩，弟[[ming-si-zong|朱由检]]即位，是为思宗。

Xizong loved carpentry and left the government to the eunuch Wei Zhongxian, who styled himself "Nine Thousand Years." The eunuch faction destroyed the Donglin men - Yang Lian, Zuo Guangdou, and others dying in prison - and in 1625 all the academies were razed, the fiercest proscription of the late Ming. On the border, Yuan Chonghuan's victory at Ningyuan in 1626 wounded Nurhaci and steadied Liaodong.

He died in 1627; his younger brother
succeeded as Sizong.

# 明思宗朱由检 · 主要事迹

朱由检（1611—1644），[[ming-guang-zong|光宗]]之子，[[ming-xi-zong|熹宗]]弟，天启七年（1627）即位，改元崇祯。

崇祯帝勤政十七年，鸡鸣而起、夜分不寐，然性刚愎多疑，十七年间更易内阁首辅五十余人、诛督师七人。崇祯三年（1630）中反间计杀袁崇焕，自毁长城；对内剿抚不定，李自成、张献忠之乱燎原；崇祯十七年（1644）三月，李自成破居庸关入北京，帝登煤山自缢，遗书「任贼分裂朕尸，勿伤百姓」，明亡。

其后清兵入关，定鼎中原（[[qing-shi-zu|清世祖]]即位）。思宗以勤政亡国之身殉社稷，「亡国之君而克己若此」，为史家所叹。

bio_parts_en.value: Zhu Youjian (1611-1644), son of
and younger brother of

, took the throne in 1627, era Chongzhen.

For seventeen years he rose before dawn and worked past midnight - yet he was rigid and suspicious, replacing more than fifty chief secretaries and executing seven commanders. In 1630, deceived by a ruse, he executed Yuan Chonghuan and broke his own shield. Against the rebels he wavered between suppression and pardon while Li Zicheng and Zhang Xianzhong spread fire across the land. In March 1644 Li Zicheng took Beijing; the emperor climbed Coal Hill and hanged himself, leaving his body to the rebels but pleading for his people. The Ming fell.

The Qing then entered the passes and took the realm (
). A diligent emperor who died with his state - "no fallen sovereign ever ruled so frugally," the histories sigh.

# 清太祖努尔哈赤 · 主要事迹

爱新觉罗努尔哈赤（1559—1626），建州女真首领，出身建州左卫，父祖为明军所杀。他以十三副遗甲起兵，先统一建州，再合海西女真，创建八旗制度——兵民合一，出则为兵、入则为民，为后金立国之基。

万历四十四年（1616）努尔哈赤即汗位于赫图阿拉，国号后金，建元天命（此时国号「后金」，1636 年太宗改国号为「清」）。天命四年（1619）萨尔浒之战，亲统八旗大破明军四路之师，辽东之局遂定；天命六年（1621）取沈阳、辽阳，迁都沈阳。

天命十一年（1626）攻宁远，为袁崇焕炮火所伤，郁郁而归，崩于途中。他开创的女真统一大业，由子孙完成入关定鼎。

bio_parts_en.value:
Aisin Gioro Nurhaci (1559-1626), chieftain of the Jianzhou Jurchen, lost his father and grandfather to Ming hands and rose with thirteen suits of armor. He united the Jianzhou, then the Haixi tribes, and created the Eight Banner system - soldier and farmer one - the foundation of the Later Jin.

In 1616 he took the khagan title at Hetu Ala, founding the Later Jin with the Tianming era (the name "Qing" came only with Taizong's change in 1636). In 1619, at Sarhu, he routed the Ming's four columns in person, deciding the fate of Liaodong; in 1621 he took Shenyang and Liaoyang, moving the capital to Shenyang.

In 1626, attacking Ningyuan, he was wounded by Yuan Chonghuan's cannon and died on the way home. His heirs completed the unification he had begun and entered the passes.

emperors.summary_en: He renamed the Later Jin to Qing and took the imperial title, campaigned in person against Joseon, and twice broke through the passes, preparing the conquest.

# 清太宗皇太极 · 主要事迹

爱新觉罗皇太极（1592—1643），[[qing-tai-zu|太祖]]第八子。天命十一年（1626）太祖崩后即位，改元天聪。

皇太极改汗称帝、改国号：天聪十年（1636）改国号后金为清，即皇帝位，改元崇德。他以汉制治汉地，设内三院、六部，崇儒重文，为入关立国完成制度准备。军事上崇德元年（1636）亲征朝鲜，仁祖出降，朝鲜由明藩臣转而称臣于清；又两度破长城入塞，掠畿辅、山东，明廷疲于奔命。

崇德八年（1643）皇太极崩于盛京，庙号太宗。他虽未及入关，而入关之基尽出于其手。

bio_parts_en.value: Aisin Gioro Hong Taiji (1592-1643), eighth son of

, took the throne in 1626, era Tiancong.

He changed the khagan title to emperor and the state's name: in 1636 the Later Jin became Qing and he assumed the imperial title, era Chongde. Ruling the Han by Han institutions, he set up the Three Inner Academies and the Six Ministries and honored Confucian learning, completing the institutional preparation for the conquest. In 1636 he campaigned in person against Joseon; King Injo surrendered and the kingdom passed from Ming vassalage to Qing. Twice his armies broke through the Great Wall, raiding the capital region and Shandong, wearing the Ming out.

He died at Shengjing in 1643, posthumously Taizong. He never entered the passes, but everything necessary for entering them was his work.

# 清世祖福临(顺治) · 主要事迹

爱新觉罗福临（1638—1661），[[qing-tai-zong|太宗]]第九子，崇德八年（1643）六岁即位，多尔衮、济尔哈朗辅政。

顺治元年（1644）多尔衮率师入关，击败李自成，定鼎北京（帝年幼，入关为摄政王统军，非亲征）。此后清廷以汉制治汉地，定科举、行顺治大婚，渐立新朝之制。顺治八年（1651）多尔衮卒，世祖亲政：整顿吏治、抑制满洲贵族，又欲用汉法。

顺治十八年（1661）世祖崩于北京，年仅二十四岁（一说出家，为清初疑案）。庙号世祖，葬孝陵。

bio_parts_en.value: Aisin Gioro Fulin (1638-1661), ninth son of

, took the throne at six in 1643 under the regency of Dorgon and Jirgalang.

In 1644 Dorgon led the army through the passes, defeated Li Zicheng, and fixed the capital at Beijing (the boy emperor did not campaign; the regent commanded). The Qing then ruled the Han by Han institutions - examinations restored, the new court taking shape. From 1651, after Dorgon's death, Shizu ruled in person: he disciplined officialdom, curbed the Manchu nobles, and leaned toward Chinese governance.

He died at Beijing in 1661 at twenty-four (a legend of abdication to a monastery persists). Posthumously Shizu, buried in Xiaoling.

emperors.bio_md:
# 清圣祖玄烨(康熙) · 主要事迹

爱新觉罗玄烨（1654—1722），[[qing-shi-zu|世祖]]第三子，顺治十八年（1661）八岁即位，四大臣辅政，康熙八年（1669）擒鳌拜亲政。

康熙一朝，武功赫赫：康熙十二年（1673）三藩之乱起，用八旗与绿营之师，历八年平定（遣将，帝未亲征）；康熙二十二年（1683）施琅平台湾，设台湾府；亲征噶尔丹——康熙三十五年（1696）出塞督师，昭莫多之战大破准噶尔，喀尔喀诸部归附；又平定准部之乱。内政上康熙二十八年（1689）与俄订尼布楚条约，划定东北边界。

康熙六十一年（1722）圣祖崩于北京。临御六十年，文治武功并盛，为有清一代之最，史称「千古一帝」。

bio_parts_en.value: Aisin Gioro Xuanye (1654-1722), third son of

, took the throne at eight in 1661; seizing the regent Oboi in 1669, he ruled in person.

His reign was one of arms and reach: the Three Feudatories rose in 1673 and were crushed in eight years by generals (the emperor did not campaign); in 1683 Shi Lang took Taiwan and a prefecture was set there; against Galdan he campaigned in person - in 1696, leading the army beyond the passes, his general Fiyanggú routed Galdan at Jao Modo and the Khalkha submitted; the Zunghar realm was broken. In 1689 the Treaty of Nerchinsk with Russia fixed the northeastern frontier.

He died at Beijing in 1722 after sixty years on the throne - unrivalled in the Qing in war and governance, "the greatest emperor."

emperors.bio_md:
# 清世宗胤禛(雍正) · 主要事迹

爱新觉罗胤禛（1678—1735），[[qing-sheng-zu|圣祖]]第四子，封雍亲王。康熙六十一年（1722）圣祖崩，胤禛即位，改元雍正。

雍正朝十三年，整饬极严：设军机处，机要政务自内阁移于军机，皇权独揽之制益密；行「摊丁入亩」，丁银并入田赋，减轻无地之民负担；行「密建储位」之制，储位之争由是稍戢；又设养廉银、整饬吏治，肃贪之厉为清帝之最。其得位之正不正（改诏之说）与治绩之严猛，历来并议。

雍正十三年（1735）世宗崩于北京，庙号世宗。其严猛之政上承康熙、下启乾隆，为康乾盛世之枢纽。

bio_parts.value:

雍正十三年（1735）世宗崩于北京，庙号世宗。其严猛之政上承康熙、下启乾隆，为康乾盛世之枢纽。

bio_parts_en.value: Aisin Gioro Yinzhen (1678-1735), fourth son of

and Prince Yong, took the throne in 1722, era Yongzheng.

His thirteen years were a stern discipline: the Grand Council was founded, drawing confidential business from the Grand Secretariat into the throne's own hands; the single-tax merged the head tax into the land levy, easing the landless; the secret succession ended the heir-apparent storms; and the campaign against corruption was the fiercest of the Qing. The legitimacy of his accession (the alleged tampering with the will) and the severity of his rule have always been debated together.

He died at Beijing in 1735. Stern as he was, his reign is the hinge between Kangxi and Qianlong.

emperors.summary_en: His "Ten Complete Campaigns" extended the empire; the Four Treasuries gathered all letters; yet beneath the splendor, officialdom rotted and the opium seed was sown.

# 清高宗弘历(乾隆) · 主要事迹

爱新觉罗弘历（1711—1799），[[qing-shi-zong-y|世宗]]第四子，雍正十三年（1735）即位，改元乾隆。

乾隆朝六十年（后禅位三年），为清之极盛：十全武功——平准部、平回部、定大小金川、降缅甸、安南、廓尔喀等（皆遣将，帝未亲征），新疆底定，版图极于今世；又开四库全书馆，集古今之书，然寓禁于征，毁书亦夥。六下江南、南巡北狩，耗帑甚巨；晚年宠和珅，吏治渐弛。

嘉庆元年（1796）内禅[[qing-ren-zong|仁宗]]，自称太上皇，训政三年；嘉庆四年（1799）崩。盛世之极，亦即衰象之萌——鸦片之芽已在乾隆晚年种下。

，自称太上皇，训政三年；嘉庆四年（1799）崩。盛世之极，亦即衰象之萌——鸦片之芽已在乾隆晚年种下。

bio_parts_en.value: Aisin Gioro Hongli (1711-1799), fourth son of

, took the throne in 1735, era Qianlong.

His sixty years (plus three as retired emperor) were the summit of Qing power: the Ten Complete Campaigns - the Zunghars and the Muslim cities pacified, Jinchuan, Burma, Vietnam, the Gurkhas - all by generals, never in person - brought the map to its greatest extent; the Four Treasuries gathered all letters, though with censorship built in and many books destroyed. Six southern tours and lavish circuits drained the treasury; in his old age Heshen rose and officialdom rotted.

In 1796 he abdicated to
and reigned on as retired emperor, dying in 1799. The zenith of the splendor was also the seedbed of decline - the opium habit was already planted.

# 清仁宗颙琰(嘉庆) · 主要事迹

爱新觉罗颙琰（1760—1820），[[qing-gao-zong|高宗]]第十五子，嘉庆元年（1796）受内禅即位，太上皇训政三年。

嘉庆四年（1799）高宗崩，仁宗亲政，即诛和珅，抄没家产达八亿两之巨（「和珅跌倒，嘉庆吃饱」）；然白莲教之乱自川楚陕蔓延九年，耗银二亿两，盛世之财尽耗于剿乱。仁宗厉行节俭、惩贪整吏，然时势已衰，救弊乏术。

嘉庆二十五年（1820）仁宗崩于热河行宫，庙号仁宗。其为守成之主，处盛世之末，有心而无力。

bio_parts.value:

嘉庆四年（1799）高宗崩，仁宗亲政，即诛和珅，抄没家产达八亿两之巨（「和珅跌倒，嘉庆吃饱」）；然白莲教之乱自川楚陕蔓延九年，耗银二亿两，盛世之财尽耗于剿乱。仁宗厉行节俭、惩贪整吏，然时势已衰，救弊乏术。

bio_parts_en.value: Aisin Gioro Yongyan (1760-1820), fifteenth son of

, took the throne by abdication in 1796, under three years of the retired emperor's tutelage.

In 1799, with his father dead, he executed Heshen and confiscated an estate worth 800 million taels - "Heshen fell, Jiaqing ate his fill." But the White Lotus revolt spread through Sichuan, Hubei, and Shaanxi for nine years, costing 200 million taels; the wealth of the splendor was spent on suppression. Frugal and anticorruption as he was, the age was past saving.

He died at the Rehe palace in 1820. A consolidator at the end of an era, willing but unable.

# 清宣宗旻宁(道光) · 主要事迹

爱新觉罗旻宁（1782—1850），[[qing-ren-zong|仁宗]]次子，嘉庆二十五年（1820）即位，改元道光。

道光朝三十年，国力已衰而国门未开：道光十九年（1839）林则徐虎门销烟；道光二十年（1840）鸦片战争起，清军屡败；道光二十二年（1842）江宁条约成，割香港、开五口通商，中国近代不平等条约之始。道光帝厉行节俭（衣袍补丁、膳费裁减），然昧于世界大势，御敌乏术。

道光三十年（1850）宣宗崩于北京，庙号宣宗。其以节俭之君逢巨变之世，老大帝国之病自此显。

道光朝三十年，国力已衰而国门未开：道光十九年（1839）林则徐虎门销烟；道光二十年（1840）鸦片战争起，清军屡败；道光二十二年（1842）江宁条约成，割香港、开五口通商，中国近代不平等条约之始。道光帝厉行节俭（衣袍补丁、膳费裁减），然昧于世界大势，御敌乏术。

道光三十年（1850）宣宗崩于北京，庙号宣宗。其以节俭之君逢巨变之世，老大帝国之病自此显。

bio_parts_en.value: Aisin Gioro Minning (1782-1850), second son of

, took the throne in 1820, era Daoguang.

His thirty years saw the state weak and the door still shut: in 1839 Lin Zexu burned the opium at Humen; in 1840 the Opium War began and the Qing lost battle after battle; in 1842 the Treaty of Nanjing ceded Hong Kong and opened five ports - the first of the unequal treaties. Daoguang himself was frugal to austerity, but blind to the wider world and without means to resist.

He died at Beijing in 1850. A thrifty emperor at the great turn, the old empire's sickness now plainly visible.

# 清文宗奕詝(咸丰) · 主要事迹

爱新觉罗奕詝（1831—1861），[[qing-xuan-zong|宣宗]]第四子，道光三十年（1850）即位，改元咸丰。

咸丰朝十一年，内忧外患交炽：咸丰元年（1851）洪秀全起于金田，太平天国蔓延东南，定都天京；咸丰六年（1856）第二次鸦片战争起，咸丰十年（1860）英法联军陷北京，焚圆明园，文宗北狩热河，留恭亲王奕訢议和，订北京条约。

咸丰十一年（1861）文宗崩于热河行在，庙号文宗。其以多难之世即位，中道而崩于行在，身后慈禧、慈安两宫垂帘之局成，同治一朝由女主临朝。

bio_parts_en.value: Aisin Gioro Yizhu (1831-1861), fourth son of

, took the throne in 1850, era Xianfeng.

His eleven years burned with troubles within and without: in 1851 Hong Xiuquan rose at Jintian and the Taiping spread across the southeast, fixing their capital at Nanjing; in 1856 the Second Opium War began; in 1860 the Anglo-French took Beijing, burned the Yuanming Yuan, and the emperor fled to Rehe, leaving Prince Gong to sign the Beijing Convention.

He died at the Rehe retreat in 1861. Enthroned in disaster, dead in exile, he left behind the regency of Cixi and Ci'an that ruled in Tongzhi's name.

# 清穆宗载淳(同治) · 主要事迹

爱新觉罗载淳（1856—1875），[[qing-wen-zong|文宗]]独子，咸丰十一年（1861）六岁即位，慈禧、慈安两宫垂帘听政。

同治三年（1864）曾国荃克天京，太平天国平；捻军亦次第定。内乱稍平，洋务运动初兴——设总理衙门、办江南制造局、福州船政局，自强之议渐起，史称「同治中兴」。然同治帝本人冲龄践祚，亲政未及二年而崩（史传死于天花），无子。

同治十三年（1875）穆宗崩，庙号穆宗。中兴之机，随之而逝。

bio_parts_en.value: Aisin Gioro Zaichun (1856-1875), only son of

, took the throne at six in 1861 under the two empresses dowager, Cixi and Ci'an.

In 1864 Zeng Guoquan took Nanjing and the Taiping were crushed; the Nian rebels fell in turn. With rebellion quelled, the Self-Strengthening began - the Zongli Yamen, the Jiangnan Arsenal, the Fuzhou shipyard - the "Tongzhi restoration." But the boy emperor ruled in name only; within two years of taking power himself he died, traditionally of smallpox, without issue.

He died in 1875, posthumously Muzong. The chance of renewal died with him.

# 清德宗载湉(光绪) · 主要事迹

爱新觉罗载湉（1871—1908），醇亲王奕譞之子，同治十三年（1875）四岁即位，慈禧太后垂帘听政。

光绪二十四年（1898）德宗用康有为、梁启超等行戊戌变法，百日而废——慈禧软禁德宗于瀛台，六君子被杀，变法尽废。光绪二十六年（1900）义和团起，八国联军入京，两宫西狩西安；辛丑条约成，赔款四亿五千万两。此后德宗虽复临朝而不得亲政，郁郁以终。

光绪三十四年（1908）德宗崩于北京（与慈禧之死前后一日，死因有疑），庙号德宗。欲变法而受制于后，忧愤以终，为末世之憾。

bio_parts_en.value:
Aisin Gioro Zaitian (1871-1908), son of Prince Chun, took the throne at four in 1875 under the regency of Empress Dowager Cixi.

In 1898 he and Kang Youwei launched the Hundred Days Reform; within a hundred days Cixi crushed it, confined the emperor to Yingtai, and executed the Six Gentlemen. In 1900 the Boxers rose; the Eight Powers took Beijing and the court fled west to Xi'an; the Boxer Protocol exacted 450 million taels. Guangxu never governed in fact again and died in grief.

He died at Beijing in 1908, one day before Cixi herself (the cause disputed). He would have reformed but was bound by the empress - the tragedy of the dynasty's end.

emperors.summary_en: Enthroned at three, he abdicated after the 1911 Revolution, ending the imperial system; his later life touched the restoration and Manchukuo, and he died in Beijing in 1967.

# 宣统帝溥仪 · 主要事迹

爱新觉罗溥仪（1906—1967），摄政王载沣之子，[[qing-de-zong|德宗]]之侄。光绪三十四年（1908）三岁即位，改元宣统，载沣摄政。

宣统三年（1911）武昌起义，各省响应；宣统三年十二月（1912 年 2 月）颁退位诏书，帝制终结。民国以优待条件待清室，溥仪居紫禁城。其后经历张勋复辟（1917）、伪满洲国（1934—1945）之变，1959 年获特赦，1967 年卒于北京。

三岁为帝，六岁逊位，一生为时代裹挟。清自顺治入关定鼎至此二百六十八年，中国帝制亦随其退位而终——图鉴以宣统收官。

bio_parts_en.value: Aisin Gioro Puyi (1906-1967), son of the regent Zaifeng and nephew of

, took the throne at three in 1908, era Xuantong, with his father as regent.

In 1911 the Wuchang Uprising spread province by province; in February 1912 the abdication edict ended the imperial system. The Republic granted the court favorable terms and Puyi remained in the Forbidden City. His later life touched the Zhang Xun restoration of 1917 and the Manchukuo puppet state (1934-1945); pardoned in 1959, he died in Beijing in 1967.

Emperor at three, abdicated at six, swept by the age. From Shunzhi's entry in 1644, the Qing had run 268 years - and with Puyi's abdication, the Chinese imperial system itself came to an end. This atlas closes with the Xuantong emperor.
